time.title: Time
time.description: Current date, time, and timezone checks.

tools.name: kuro-web::get_current_time
tools.when: Use when the answer depends on the current local time or timezone.

web_research.title: Web Research
web_research.description: Public web search, source reading, and time-sensitive verification.

tools.name: kuro-web::search_web
tools.when: Use for a quick first pass when titles, snippets, and URLs are enough.

tools.name: kuro-web::advanced_search_web
tools.when: Use for source-sensitive research, latest/current questions, official documentation, comparison, or any answer that should cite evidence.

tools.name: kuro-web::smart_search_web
tools.when: Compatibility search tool for practical, time-sensitive, multi-source, or comparison questions.

tools.name: kuro-web::fetch_content
tools.when: Use after a candidate URL is known and the page body needs verification.

local_files.title: Local Files
local_files.description: Read-only Project Workspace inspection. Use workspace_info for root ids, then root plus relative path (project for project_context; files[].path for read_files). Never pass old absolute-path aliases.

tools.name: project-workspace::workspace_info
tools.when: Discover configured roots, limits and deny policy before inspecting a workspace.

tools.name: project-workspace::list_dir
tools.when: Inspect folder structure with bounded depth and entry count.

tools.name: project-workspace::find_files
tools.when: Find file names with a relative glob pattern.

tools.name: project-workspace::search_text
tools.when: Search text with a bounded query within a configured root.

tools.name: project-workspace::read_file
tools.when: Read a known relative file path with bounded lines.

tools.name: project-workspace::read_files
tools.when: Read a bounded list of files using files objects with relative path fields.

tools.name: project-workspace::project_context
tools.when: Read project entrypoint context using the project relative path field.

file_attachments.title: File Attachments
file_attachments.description: Uploaded file understanding. Text/code files are summarized, archives are safely listed with small text samples, and binaries/executables receive static analysis only.

media.title: Media
media.description: Image/audio attachment understanding. Use web research when visual content needs external lookup or verification.

tools.name: kuro-web::advanced_search_web
tools.when: Use after visually inspecting an attached image and deriving textual search terms for objects, products, locations, visible text, sources, facts, or fictional/illustrated/anime/game/VTuber characters that need external verification. Do not use it to identify a private real person by face.

tools.name: kuro-web::search_web
tools.when: Use for a quick visual follow-up search when the image gives a clear textual query.

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Kuro 本機角色記憶與聊天脈絡；以唯讀 history 工具查詢過往對話，與外部 Memory Core 分開。

tools.name: kuro-filesystem::search_past_conversations
tools.when: Use when the user asks about previous chats, prior decisions, old context, or details that may exist in raw chat history but not in long-term memory.

mail.title: Mail
mail.description: Gmail read-only authorization, unread mail, recent search, and daily brief snapshots.

tools.name: kuro-mail::mail.auth_status
tools.when: Use to check whether Gmail OAuth is configured and authorized.

tools.name: kuro-mail::mail.auth_start
tools.when: Use only when the user asks to connect or re-authorize Gmail.

tools.name: kuro-mail::mail.auth_finish
tools.when: Use only after the user provides the Google OAuth redirected URL.

tools.name: kuro-mail::mail.list_unread
tools.when: Use for unread Gmail summaries. It does not mark mail as read.

tools.name: kuro-mail::mail.search_recent
tools.when: Use for recent Gmail searches by sender, subject, keyword, or Gmail query syntax.

tools.name: kuro-mail::mail.get_message_summary
tools.when: Use when a specific Gmail message id needs a metadata/snippet summary.

tools.name: kuro-mail::mail.get_message_detail
tools.when: Use only when the user asks to open or read a specific Gmail message body. It does not download attachments or modify the mailbox.

tools.name: kuro-mail::mail.daily_brief
tools.when: Use for an explicit read-only Gmail summary using saved preferences. This provider query is distinct from Core Today and does not update it.

tools.name: kuro-mail::mail.refresh
tools.when: Use when the user explicitly requests a Mail refresh. It publishes bounded Mail status/work handoffs for Core Today and does not modify the mailbox.

market_intelligence.title: Market Intelligence
market_intelligence.description: OMI Search v4 cache-only data. Use canonical question, target and mode=data_only; refresh_if_missing=false. Never pass caller_profile/allow_llm/allow_write/allow_external_fetch. Preserve stale, partial, missing and backend limitations. No provider refresh, LLM synthesis, runtime control or MCP Apps.

tools.name: omi-search::omi_ask
tools.when: 由 OMI Search 取得 v4 既有證據；僅 data_only，不刷新、不呼叫 LLM、不寫入。

tools.name: omi-search::omi_read_refresh_status
tools.when: 只讀既有工作狀態，不發起或重送刷新。

tools.name: omi-search::omi_read_market_overview
tools.when: 讀取 OMI 已有市場資料；保留缺漏與過期警告。

tools.name: omi-search::omi_read_stock_context
tools.when: 讀取既有個股證據，不刷新來源。

tools.name: omi-search::omi_read_data_freshness
tools.when: 讀取 OMI 資料時間與缺漏狀態，不修復或刷新。

tools.name: omi-search::omi_read_source_health
tools.when: 只讀來源狀態，不啟停服務。

tools.name: omi-search::omi_read_capability_status
tools.when: 查看 OMI 已登錄能力及可用性。

tools.name: omi-search::omi_read_tw_market_dashboard
tools.when: 讀取台股總覽資料；不開啟 widget。

tools.name: omi-search::omi_search_tw_symbols
tools.when: 查找台股名稱與代號，不查詢外部 provider。

tools.name: omi-search::omi_read_tw_stock_dashboard_detail
tools.when: 讀取既有個股總覽明細，保留來源限制。

tools.name: omi-search::omi_read_tw_workspace_header
tools.when: 讀取現有市場摘要與時間狀態。

tools.name: omi-search::omi_read_tw_workspace_watchlist
tools.when: 唯讀現有自選股，不新增或修改清單。

tools.name: omi-search::omi_read_tw_workspace_hot_groups
tools.when: 讀取既有族群資料，不自行重算排名。

tools.name: omi-search::omi_read_tw_stock_chart
tools.when: 讀取既有圖表資料，不執行 MCP Apps UI。

tools.name: omi-search::omi_read_tw_stock_research
tools.when: 讀取既有研究證據，不產生 LLM 報告。

runtime_control.title: Runtime Control
runtime_control.description: Reserved category for launcher/runtime status and controlled restart actions.

japanese_study.title: japanese-study
japanese_study.description: Read-only existing source data. No creation, submission, recording, audio preparation, synthesis or widget. Source offline/auth failure is not an empty result; independent of Core Today.

tools.name: japanese-study::study_get_summary
tools.when: 唯讀 Japanese Study Hub 摘要；與 Core Today 投影分開。

tools.name: japanese-study::study_get_learner_policy
tools.when: 讀取既有學習設定，不修改規則。

tools.name: japanese-study::study_get_learning_context
tools.when: 讀取既有學習脈絡，不建立或記錄練習。

tools.name: japanese-study::study_search_items
tools.when: 搜尋既有單字與文法項目。

tools.name: japanese-study::study_get_item
tools.when: 唯讀指定學習項目。

tools.name: japanese-study::study_get_due_reviews
tools.when: 讀取到期待複習項目，不提交作答。

tools.name: japanese-study::study_get_plan
tools.when: 讀取 Hub 提供的學習計畫，不另建排程。

tools.name: japanese-study::study_list_study_lists
tools.when: 列出既有學習清單，不新增或修改清單。

tools.name: japanese-study::study_list_practice_sessions
tools.when: 有界查找既有練習紀錄，不寫入成績。

tools.name: japanese-study::study_get_practice_session
tools.when: 唯讀指定練習紀錄。

english_study.title: english-study
english_study.description: Read-only existing source data. No creation, submission, recording, audio preparation, synthesis or widget. Source offline/auth failure is not an empty result; independent of Core Today.

tools.name: english-study::english_get_summary
tools.when: 唯讀 English Study Hub 摘要；與 Core Today 投影分開。

tools.name: english-study::english_search_items
tools.when: 搜尋既有英文學習項目。

tools.name: english-study::english_get_item
tools.when: 唯讀指定英文項目。

tools.name: english-study::english_get_due_reviews
tools.when: 讀取到期待複習項目，不提交作答。

tools.name: english-study::english_get_plan
tools.when: 讀取 Hub 提供的學習計畫，不另建排程。

tools.name: english-study::english_search_reference_entries
tools.when: 搜尋既有參考條目，不下載或匯入資料。

tools.name: english-study::english_get_reference_entry
tools.when: 唯讀指定參考資料。

tools.name: english-study::english_get_ielts_progress
tools.when: 讀取既有進度，不推測成績或記錄新結果。

tools.name: english-study::english_list_practice_sessions
tools.when: 有界查找既有練習紀錄。

tools.name: english-study::english_get_practice_session
tools.when: 唯讀指定練習紀錄，不修改或補交。

listening_audio.title: listening-audio
listening_audio.description: Read-only existing source data. No creation, submission, recording, audio preparation, synthesis or widget. Source offline/auth failure is not an empty result; independent of Core Today.

tools.name: listening-audio::listening_health
tools.when: 讀取 Trainer 與 TTS 狀態；不啟動服務，狀態不代表合成成功。

tools.name: listening-audio::listening_get_question
tools.when: 讀取安全題目與音訊可用性；不合成、不開啟 widget。

tools.name: listening-audio::listening_get_attempt_result
tools.when: 讀取既有作答結果，不提交答案或寫入 Study。

memory_core.description: Memory Core 是 ChatGPT 端的外部長期個人記憶；Kuro MCP 接線目前暫停，與 Kuro 角色記憶及聊天歷史分開。
memory_core.policy: On user request only; public read-only projection, no polling, caching, writes or administrative operations. Preserve source time/quality. Independent of Kuro history, character memory and Core Today.

tools.name: memory-core::search
tools.when: 依使用者需求搜尋 Memory Core；與 Kuro 過往對話及角色記憶分開。

tools.name: memory-core::fetch
tools.when: 依穩定識別碼讀取外部正式記憶，不保存或修改記憶。

tools.name: memory-core::memory_fetch_record_revision
tools.when: 唯讀指定紀錄的歷史版本。

tools.name: memory-core::memory_list_record_links
tools.when: 唯讀指定紀錄的關聯，不建立或移除關聯。

tools.name: memory-core::memory_overview
tools.when: 按需讀取 Memory Core 概覽；不是 Kuro History 或 Core Today。

tools.name: memory-core::memory_detect_duplicates
tools.when: 唯讀可能重複的紀錄；不合併、刪除或封存。

tools.name: memory-core::memory_list_collections
tools.when: 唯讀列出可見集合，不建立或修改集合。

tools.name: memory-core::memory_get_collection
tools.when: 有界讀取指定集合的成員，不自動寫入長期記憶。

personal_asset_os.policy: On user request only; public read-only projection, no polling, caching, writes or administrative operations. Preserve source time/quality. Independent of Kuro history, character memory and Core Today.

tools.name: personal-asset-os::get_asset_overview
tools.when: 查詢資產總額、淨值、資產配置或資產總覽；保留 Broker／FX 來源時間與品質警告。系統健康查詢使用 get_asset_system_status。

tools.name: personal-asset-os::list_asset_accounts
tools.when: 查詢資產帳戶清單與帳戶餘額；唯讀，不調整帳務。

tools.name: personal-asset-os::list_asset_positions
tools.when: 查詢持倉、股票部位與投資部位；保留 Broker／FX 來源限制，不下單或刷新交易。

tools.name: personal-asset-os::list_recent_asset_transactions
tools.when: 讀取近期交易、成交與買賣紀錄；不新增、沖銷或修改交易。

tools.name: personal-asset-os::get_pending_financial_events
tools.when: 讀取待處理財務事件及其待辦；不核准或寫入帳本。

tools.name: personal-asset-os::get_reconciliation_status
tools.when: 查詢對帳狀況、帳務一致性與既有對帳證據；不執行對帳。

tools.name: personal-asset-os::get_asset_system_status
tools.when: 查詢 PAOS 服務或個人資產系統是否正常、可用性、連線與來源健康；只讀狀態，不啟停、備份或還原服務。
